dialect.detail: IBM CICS/DB2 online program; uses EXEC CICS and EXEC SQL with SQLCA, EIB fields (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN), DFHCOMMAREA, and ABEND command — classic IBM mainframe CICS/DB2 pattern

purpose.domain_detail: Hospital/clinic prescription management system — inserts prescription schedule rows into a DB2 PRESCRIPTION table for a given patient, based on start/end dates and dosage frequency
purpose.summary: HCMADB02 is a CICS online subprogram that receives a commarea containing patient ID, prescription ID, start/end dates, and frequency. It iterates day-by-day over the date range and inserts one or more timed prescription records per day into the DB2 PRESCRIPTION table according to the specified frequency (1–4 times daily).

notable_features: EXEC SQL INSERT with DB2 host variables
SQLCA included via EXEC SQL INCLUDE
DFHCOMMAREA with EXEC SQL INCLUDE HCCMAREA
Date arithmetic using FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE and FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER
EVALUATE on CA-FREQUENCY for 1–4 times daily scheduling
COPY HCERRSWS and COPY HCERRSPD for error handling
EIB fields usage (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN)
Commented-out date validation code with %regi fix markers
verdict.notes: Program is part of a healthcare (HCM) application suite, likely the IBM Z Explorers / zHealthcare demo or similar IBM-provided sample. Comment references 'DEMO' and a fix date of June 22 2020 by 'Regi'. No lines exceed 72 characters confirming fixed format. The LINKAGE SECTION uses EXEC SQL INCLUDE HCCMAREA to define DFHCOMMAREA fields, which is an unusual but valid IBM pattern.
